articles.title: How Man City overhauled their squad from a 650,000-strong database
articles.summary: BBC Sport goes inside Manchester City's data team, who have been a key part of their rebuild over the past 18 months.

articles.title: Premier League in joint call for FIFA reform amid Infantino crisis
articles.summary: The Premier League and three of its top European counterparts will on Friday issue a joint call for urgent governance reform at FIFA amid the crisis engulfing its president, Gianni Infantino.

articles.title: Buttler injury halts England as Sri Lanka level series
articles.summary: Sri Lanka showed great fight to halt England’s chase and clinch a 16-run victory, levelling the three-match ODI series at 1-1 at Headingley in Leeds.
